open_points.subject: flow:create_and_correct_project and flow:publish_and_withdraw_pointer
open_points.text: “Cabinet Kernel adds a room for the agent on a project its session is granted (A09 rule 2).” “Cabinet Kernel, for the agent, publishes an artifact pointer on a project its session is granted or withdraws one; the owner does the same in the owner interface (A08 rule 1, R0-88).”
open_points.question: Where in each agent-write flow does Kernel obtain or apply the owner's exact-request or standing approval required by R0-99, which named Kernel capability performs it, and what result does denial, cancellation or expiry produce?
options: Add an explicit pre-call Kernel approval step; on denial, cancellation or expiry the node fails or is refused and Registry is not called.
Define the Registry flow as beginning only after Kernel's approval gate and state that all approval outcomes belong to the Kernel flow.
Treat standing approval and interactive approval as separate trigger paths and specify the outcome of each.
open_points.default_guess: Define an explicit external Kernel gate before the Registry call, allow either exact-request or valid standing approval, and make every unsuccessful approval end the node without calling Registry.

witness.initial: An active project is granted to an agent session, and the flow version has no standing approval.
events: The agent reaches an add-room, publish-pointer or withdraw-pointer node.
Kernel prepares the exact Registry request.
The owner declines the request or the approval ceases to be valid.
outcomes: Kernel reports the node as a refused or failed approval and makes no Registry call.
Kernel treats the node as cancelled or skipped and makes no Registry call.
witness.observer: The owner and the agent inspecting the Kernel run see different node outcomes.

open_points.subject: owner reads used to answer a data subject request
open_points.text: “PresuPro, Client Portal or Cabinet calls a read its row allows (A09 rule 2): validate a project reference, read a project context, read a project, list projects, list rooms, list artifacts, read the latest artifact of a type.”
open_points.question: Which owner-triggered flow and calls provide the R0-93 sequence of listing projects including archived ones, reading each project and listing its artifacts, and what failures does each owner read return?
options: Extend this read flow with an owner branch through perform_owner_operation, reusing projects and artifact_pointers capabilities.
Add a separate owner-read flow composed from the existing capabilities, without adding the candidate aggregate operation.
Leave project reads embedded in create_and_correct_project and add only an owner list-artifacts step elsewhere.
open_points.default_guess: Add a separate owner-read flow using the existing list_projects, read_project_card and list_pointers capabilities through perform_owner_operation; do not add a customer-gathering operation.

witness.initial: A customer has an archived project with an artifact pointer, and asks for a copy of all Registry data about them.
events: The owner lists projects including archived ones and identifies the project by customer_ref.
The owner attempts to read the project and list its artifacts.
outcomes: The owner interface exposes all three existing reads and the owner assembles the response.
The owner can read the project card but has no owner operation for listing its artifacts, so the response cannot be assembled from the stated flows.
witness.observer: The owner, and ultimately the customer receiving the response, sees whether the artifact information is included.
